errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The change was refused: by the organization's gateway, or as the account may not make it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

warning.description: Set when the change was made only in part, saying what is left.

main.description: Deletes the account's dev.knotless.orgAcceptance records naming the organization, then asks its gateway to take the account out (dev.knotless.leaveOrg). The membership ends with the records: a gateway that does not answer leaves a warning. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview acts with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session call the organization's gateway themselves.

description: Leaves an organization as the account logged in to this appview's pages, or declines its invitation, as `knotless org leave` does.
